correctness.rationale: The comparison-state automaton A=[[D,U],[D,0]], with D strictly descending and U weakly ascending, has one closed state path per cyclic word without two consecutive weak ascents, including n=1,2. Its Schur complement gives det(I-zA)=det(I-zD+z^2D^2-z^2 1(1^T D)); nilpotence and (1-t+t^2)^-1=(1+t)/(1+t^3) yield the six-periodic c_r and 1^T D^(r+1)1=binom(q,r+2). Hence exact Delta_q, C_q(m)=[z^m](-zDelta_q'/Delta_q) for ALL q,m. Burnside and Möbius count necklaces and primitive orbits, including periodic words. Explicit 2- and 3-loops establish existence q>=3 for all m>=2; q=2 requires alternating cycles. An independent brute count agreed in 35 cases (q<=5, m<=7, q^m<=100000).
